morgan_sec: FYI incoming pentest report — assessor found a container escape path in staging. Repro shows role chaining into kms:Decrypt. Need containment + evidence collection + retest plan. I created ticket INF-4572. /cc @jordan_oncall @leila_devops

jordan_oncall: Acknowledged. Which containment first: revoke roles or rotate keys?

leila_devops: Start by revoking ephemeral sessions and blocking egress from the job-runner subnet. Then rotate affected KMS keys and schedule a scoped retest with MFA enforced roles. I'll draft commands. :wrench:

sam_engineer: Can we get the exact principal ARNs and timestamps they used? Need CloudTrail + runner syslogs for the window.

morgan_sec: Assessor included a minimal repro and event chain. They did sts:AssumeRole -> kms:Decrypt using role trust that unexpectedly allowed cross-account. Link to artifact: https://files.redwood/pt/INF-4572/proof.tar.gz

leila_devops: Draft containment steps: 
1) Disable staging runners (label: pt-scope)
2) Apply network policy deny-egress: job-runner-subnet
3) Rotate/disable KMS key alias and create new key alias
4) Create short-lived service role for retest with MFA required

Command snippets:
```bash
# revoke role sessions (example)
aws sts revoke-session --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/staging-runner
# schedule key rotation / temporary disable
aws kms disable-key --key-id alias/staging-key
```

jordan_oncall: For the evidence package we need CloudTrail (DataEvents), KMS logs, and runner syslogs. Sam — can you run queries and post counts + S3 path?

sam_engineer: Running CloudTrail query for kms:Decrypt between 2026-03-15T00:00Z..2026-03-16T00:00Z. Query:
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters.keyId
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventName='Decrypt' AND requestParameters.keyId='alias/staging-key';
```
Expecting ~12 events. Saving output to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/INF-4572/ (will tar and sha256)

devsec-bot: Ticket INF-4572 created: <https://tracker.redwood/INF-4572|view ticket>. Assigned to @morgan_sec, @leila_devops. Reminder: follow ephemeral creds playbook: https://docs.redwood/sec/ephemeral-roles

anya_prod: Any customer data exposure? Looks like QA but some datasets mirror prod. Do we notify privacy/legal now?

morgan_sec: No PII found in initial sample but assume high risk until proven otherwise. Notifying legal and privacy now. Treat as high severity.

jordan_oncall: Proposed retest window: 2026-03-18 09:00-12:00 PT. Final sign-off needed by 2026-03-17 EOD. Who is the approver?

leila_devops: I'll execute containment today and post evidence of rollback. Key rotation needs a maintenance window — ETA ~4 hours. Will coordinate with infra.

sam_engineer: Evidence upload complete: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/INF-4572/ — tar: proof.tar.gz, sha256: abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890

leila_devops: Minimal IAM trust policy for short-lived retest role (MFA required):
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/pt-assessor"},
      "Action":"sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent":"true"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

jordan_oncall: Also request CloudTrail/Data Access logs for KMS pointed to S3 with object lock enabled for 90 days. I'll open an infra ticket for log retention and immutability.

morgan_sec: Good. If anyone sees any unexpected access during containment ping here @channel. We'll run a pre-retest dry run on 2026-03-17 16:00 PT to validate the harness and audit hooks. Post any blockers here. :eyes:
